summary: All three SPA frontends are now fully localized into English, Malay (Bahasa Melayu), Chinese Simplified, and Tamil via a new lightweight, dependency-free i18n system in the shared frontend module. A LangProvider/useT() context pair plus flat per-locale dictionaries (frontend/shared/src/i18n/index.js and per-app i18n.js files) power translation with {placeholder} interpolation and a safe English fallback. An inline LanguageDropdown (English | Melayu | 中文 | தமிழ்) appears in each app's top bar and persists the selection to localStorage. Shared components (DataTable, SideNav, Toast) now use useT() for their own chrome. A new AppFooter component (frontend/shared/src/AppFooter.js) renders at the bottom of every app shell, displaying the app name, app/core version, short commit hash, and build date fetched from /api/version plus the r450k product tagline; all version fields degrade gracefully when the endpoint is unreachable.
compatibility: Fully backward-compatible. With no LangProvider mounted, useT() resolves to English, so every component that has not yet been wired to a provider continues to render unchanged. The active language defaults to English on first load; users who have a stored language preference see it applied immediately. No server-side changes are required — the i18n system is entirely frontend-only.
